TASK T0:
Decide whether the sentinel ownership scheme should move from the filename to a body field, given that six readers hand-copy the parser and two must stay builtin-only. Write the decision and its trade-offs into DECISIONS.md. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.

TASK T1:
The holdout suite and the in-repo shell suite disagree on whether a verdict row with empty evidence may be recorded. Determine which one encodes the charter correctly and propose the fix for the other. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.

TASK T2:
Review the base-gate arm 3 design: it judges the merged tree against the base floors. Identify every way a PR could lower a floor without arm 3 going red, and rank them by exploitability. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.

TASK T3:
Design how the Stop hook's loop guard should interact with a sibling plugin that also blocks Stop, so neither can disarm the other. Produce the invariant set and the failure each one prevents. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.

TASK T4:
Choose between byte caps and line caps for the ledger reader, given NUL bytes are discarded by read and a single 2 MB line hung the scan. Justify with the measured cases. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.

TASK T5:
Audit the six validator pins added in 0.11.9 for vacuity: for each, decide whether its mutation actually goes red in the gate it names, and say which are hypotheses. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.

TASK T6:
Implement --target on ops-verdict.sh: parse the flag, thread it into the row key the cap detector reads, keep the 4-cell row shape, and add red-first cases to tests/test-scripts.sh. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.

TASK T7:
Strip the whole trailing CR run (bounded by CAPS_MAX_CR) in ops-reverify.sh's row parser, matching lib/caps.sh's loop, and add the \r\r\n case with its LF control. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.

TASK T8:
Add a --json output mode to ops-tiers.sh that emits the resolved tier-to-model map, keeping the text mode byte-identical, with cases for both modes and an unknown tier. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.

TASK T9:
Make scan_caps cache its result keyed on the ledger's content hash plus the lib's own bytes, falling back to a full scan on any cache failure, with a same-size FAIL-to-PASS edit case. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.

TASK T10:
Add the spec Status gate to workflows/plan.js: read the column-0 Status line, require first-token APPROVED, refuse before any dispatch, and cover NOT-APPROVED and a missing line in the node suite. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.

TASK T11:
Port the MALFORMED bucket from scan_pending into statusline.sh's BLOCKING count so the bar and the Stop hook agree, and add the case where only a malformed sentinel is pending. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.

TASK T12:
Add ops-backlog.sh to the _OPS_TOOLS literal in scripts/ops-install-set.sh and bump the two tests that count the install set from 6 to 7. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.

TASK T13:
Bump plugin.json version to 0.12.14 and add a matching '## [0.12.14]' heading as the newest entry in CHANGELOG.md with the provided release notes. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.

TASK T14:
Run the five gate-suite rungs (validator, python, shell, workflows, compress) one after another and report each completion marker line verbatim. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.

TASK T15:
Rename the label 'lens:provider' to 'lens:providers' in workflows/review.js and in the one test assertion in tests/test_workflows.mjs that names it. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.

TASK T16:
Raise FLOOR_SHELL in tests/floors.env from 1386 to 1420 to match the suite's current passed+skipped count. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.

TASK T17:
Create tests/fixtures/crlf-ledger.md with exactly the three rows given below, CRLF line endings, no trailing newline. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.

TASK T18:
Find every file in the repo that references CAPS_MAX_CR and report the paths and line numbers. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.

TASK T19:
List every agentType string used across workflows/*.js and which workflow uses each. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.

TASK T20:
Locate where ops-sessionstart-hook.sh wipes .autobar/ and .stopguard/, and quote the lines. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.

TASK T21:
Report which GitHub issues are still open with the label 'blocked', with their titles. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.

TASK T22:
Find the case titles in tests/test-scripts.sh that mention F136 and print them. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.

TASK T23:
Which scripts under scripts/ source lib/partition.sh? List them. Straightforward one; no need to overthink it.
